simple.meaning: צָנִיף (tsânîyph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a head-dress (i.e. piece of cloth wrapped around).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 6 times across Job, Isaiah, Zechariah, beginning at Job 29:14. Its contexts include righteousness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צָנִיף (H6797).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
